result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of dedicated walkways, marked crossings, or signals at a wide, multi-lane intersection. The road geometry features wide-radius turns that likely encourage high vehicle speeds, while the absence of infrastructure forces any pedestrians to navigate unprotected asphalt.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks and marked crosswalks forces pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground intersection area.

hazards.name: Wide Turn Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface can cause tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Provide a continuous, paved path for pedestrians separated from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and provide signalized crossing phases.

interventions.title: Corner Radii Reduction
interventions.description: Tighten the turn radius to slow down turning vehicles and shorten crossing distances.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, high-speed arterial intersection with a 40 mph speed limit and no visible pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. The environment is heavily car-oriented, featuring long crossing distances and minimal separation between pedestrians and high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this large intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space.

hazards.name: High Speed Traffic

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road that is highly hostile to pedestrians despite the presence of a bus stop. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross a large expanse of pavement without protection.

interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.
